title: Jaguars Defense Drowns Ravens in Rainy Baltimore

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaguars Defense Drowns Ravens in Rainy Baltimore
sources.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars weathered the storm in Baltimore, and the Ravens had no answer for the elements or Anthony Campanile’s defense. In a rainy Thursday night showdown, Jacksonville completely smothered Baltimore, turning a hostile road environment into a blowout victory. Here’s everything you need to know from Jacksonville’s Week 9 33-10 road win over the […]
